13.1 大语言模型: 评估大语言模型
Large Language Models (LLMs): Evaluating Large Language Models

学习目标; 评估一个 LLM 是什么意思
Learning goals · What does it mean to evaluate an LLM?

Slide 0–1

Deep Learning for NLP — Large Language Models (LLMs) — Evaluating Large Language Models

Learning goals

  • understand major evaluation paradigms for LLMs
  • understand MMLU, MT-Bench, Chatbot Arena, and IFEval
  • compute simple evaluation scores such as accuracy and Bradley–Terry probabilities
  • understand calibration metrics and benchmark contamination

We care about model behavior: knowledge, reasoning, helpfulness, instruction following.

Evaluation turns this into a measurement: capability ⟶ task ⟶ metric ⟶ score

目标: 理解 LLM 的主要评估范式; 理解 MMLU、MT-Bench、Chatbot Arena 和 IFEval; 会算简单的评估分数 (准确率、Bradley–Terry 概率); 理解校准指标和基准污染. 我们关心的是模型的行为: 知识、推理、有帮助、遵循指令. 评估把它变成测量: 能力 → 任务 → 指标 → 分数. 每一步都会损失信息: 一个分数只反映所选任务、所选指标下的那一面.

MMLU 和 MMLU-Pro
MMLU: broad evaluation with a simple format · MMLU-Pro: extending MMLU

Slide 2–3

MMLU evaluates models on multiple-choice questions from 57 academic and professional subjects. Hendrycks et al., 2020

  • Objective answer key.
  • Cheap and reproducible evaluation.
  • One aggregate score over many domains.

MMLU became a canonical broad-capability benchmark.

As models improve, benchmarks can become less discriminative. Benchmarks must evolve as models improve.

MMLU-Pro extends MMLU by Wang et al., 2024

  • increasing answer choices from 4 to 10,
  • removing trivial and noisy questions,
  • emphasizing more reasoning-intensive questions.

MMLU (Massive Multitask Language Understanding): 57 个学科 (从初等数学到法律、医学) 的四选一选择题. 优点: 答案客观; 便宜、可复现; 一个总分覆盖很多领域. 它成了衡量广泛能力的标准基准. 例题: 「政府阻止和管制垄断的原因之一是 (D) 消费者剩余因更高的价格和更低的产量而损失」; 「复平面上满足 z2=∣z∣2 的点集是 (D) 一条直线」(设 z = a + bi, z2=∣z∣2 要求 a2−b2+2abi=a2+b2, 得 b = 0, 即实轴).

模型越来越强, 基准的区分度就会下降 (大家都接近满分), 基准必须跟着进化. MMLU-Pro: 选项从 4 个增加到 10 个 (随机猜从 25% 降到 10%), 去掉过于简单和有噪声的题, 加重需要推理的题. 读图: 左: 各模型在 MMLU-Pro 上比 MMLU 低 16–33 分; 中: 换 24 种提示, MMLU-Pro 上的准确率分布更窄 (对提示更不敏感, 评估更稳定); 右: 在 MMLU-Pro 上用思维链 (CoT) 比直接回答好得多, 而在 MMLU 上差别不大, 说明 MMLU-Pro 更考推理.

MT-Bench 与 LLM 当评委
MT-Bench: open-ended multi-turn evaluation · LLM-as-a-judge

Slide 4–5

MT-Bench contains 80 multi-turn questions across eight categories. Each item contains an initial request and a follow-up: x1​→y1​→x2​→y2​.

Question: If there is no unique reference answer, how should we score y1​,y2​?

A language model can itself act as an evaluator. Zheng et al., 2023

For pairwise comparison, (x,yA​,yB​)⟶ LLM judge ⟶ A, B, tie.

For single-answer grading, the judge assigns a score, e.g. from 1 to 10.

MT-Bench: 80 道多轮题, 分 8 类 (写作、角色扮演、推理、数学、编程、信息提取、STEM、人文社科). 每道题有初始请求和一个追问: x1​→y1​→x2​→y2​. 读表: 写作: 先写一篇夏威夷旅行博客, 再「把你的回答改写成每句都以字母 A 开头」; 数学: 给定 f(x)=4x3−9x−14 求 f(2) (= 32 − 18 − 14 = 0), 追问「求 x 使 f(x) = 0」(由第一问 x = 2 是一个根); 知识: 解释 GDP、通胀、失业率的关系, 追问「像对五岁孩子那样再解释一遍」. 第二轮考的是在上下文中延续和修改的能力.

开放式的回答没有唯一的标准答案, 怎么打分? 让一个 (强) 语言模型当评委 (LLM-as-a-judge): 成对比较时输入问题和两个回答, 评委判 A 胜、B 胜或平局; 单个打分时评委给 1–10 分. 读图: 评委的系统提示要求它当公正的评委, 考虑有帮助性、相关性、准确性、深度、创造性和细节; 先比较再给简短解释; 避免位置偏差 (回答出现的顺序不能影响判断)、不能被长度影响、不能偏向助手的名字; 最后严格按格式输出「[[A]]」「[[B]]」或「[[C]]」(平局).

评委与人的一致性; 评委的偏差
Judge-human agreement · Biases of LLM judges

Slide 6–7

Zheng et al. measure how often different judges make the same preference decision between two responses.

  • Setting S1: choices are A wins / B wins / tie, random agreement R = 33%.
  • Setting S2: choices are A wins / B wins, random agreement R = 50%.

On first-turn non-tie cases: GPT-4 vs. human = 85%, human vs. human = 81%.

Zheng et al. study several systematic judge biases.

  • Position bias: preference may change when answer order is swapped.
  • Verbosity bias: longer answers may be preferred.
  • Self-enhancement bias: models may favor their own outputs.
  • Limited reasoning: judges can be misled by plausible errors.

Zheng 等衡量不同评委对同一对回答做出相同判断的频率. S1: 三选项 (A 胜/B 胜/平), 随机一致率 33%; S2: 只看不含平局的情况, 随机一致率 50%. 读表: 第一轮 S2 下, GPT-4 成对评判和人的一致率 85%, 两个人之间只有 81%: GPT-4 评委和人的一致程度不亚于人和人之间. S1 下 GPT-4 和人约 66%, 人和人约 63%.

LLM 评委的系统性偏差: 位置偏差 (交换两个回答的顺序, 判断可能改变); 长度偏差 (更偏爱更长的回答); 自我增强偏差 (偏爱自己生成的回答); 推理有限 (会被看似合理的错误误导, 如数学题). 读图: 问「在日本做生意有哪些商务礼仪?」, A 和 B 两个回答; A 在前时 GPT-4 判 A 更详细更好, 交换顺序 B 在前时又判 B 更好: 它总是偏向第一个位置. 常用的对策: 两种顺序各评一次, 结果不一致就算平局.

G-Eval 与「评估评估者」
G-Eval: designing the judge · Evaluating the evaluator

Slide 8–9

Another LLM-as-a-judge approach is G-Eval Liu et al., 2023: G-Eval

The judge receives task introduction, evaluation criteria, generated evaluation steps, the candidate output.

Rather than use only the most likely integer score, G-Eval computes score=∑i=1n​p(si​)si​, where si​ are allowed ratings and p(si​) their re-scaled output-token probabilities.

Standard meta-evaluation measures agreement with a global human ranking. Xu et al., 2025: The Progress Illusion

But can an evaluator distinguish similarly strong systems? Consider only pairs with small evaluator score difference: ∣S(π1​;E)−S(π2​;E)∣<Δ

For LC AlpacaEval 2.0: τ=0.869, τΔ<2​=0.196.

G-Eval (Liu et al. 2023) 是另一种 LLM 评委: 评委收到任务介绍、评估标准、(由模型自动生成的) 评估步骤和待评输出. 不直接取概率最大的那个整数分, 而是用各分数词元的概率加权平均: score=∑i​p(si​)si​. 读图: 评估新闻摘要的「连贯性」(1–5 分): 模型对 1–5 分各有一个概率, 加权和是 2.59. 这样得到连续的分数, 能区分「都是 3 分」的不同输出, 和人评的相关性更高.

怎么评估「评估者」本身? 标准的做法是看它给的模型排名和人的全局排名是否一致 (Kendall τ). Xu 等 (2025) 指出: 真正有用的是能否区分实力相近的系统. 只看评估器分差小于 Δ 的模型对: 长度控制版 AlpacaEval 2.0 整体 τ = 0.869 (看起来很可靠), 但在分差小于 2 的模型对上 τ 只有 0.196, 接近随机. 读表: 所有评估器都是 Δ 越小 τ 越低, 甚至为负; 也就是说排行榜上相邻的两个模型谁更强, 这些自动评估器基本判断不了 (论文标题: 「进步的幻觉」).

Chatbot Arena 与 Bradley–Terry 模型
Chatbot Arena: human preference at scale · From votes to rankings: Bradley–Terry · Exercise

Slide 10–13

Chatbot Arena evaluates models through anonymous pairwise comparisons. Chiang et al., 2024: Chatbot Arena

user prompt → {Model A response, Model B response} → human vote.

  • Users supply real prompts.
  • Model identities are hidden during voting.
  • Pairwise votes are aggregated into rankings.

(Slide 11: Screenshot der Chatbot-Arena-Oberfläche mit zwei anonymen Antworten und Abstimmungsknöpfen.)

Arena-style rankings can be modeled with Bradley–Terry scores. For models i and j,

P(i≻j)=exp(xi(i)​)+exp(xj(i)​)exp(xi(i)​)​=σ(xi(i)​−xj(i)​).
  • xi(i)​: latent strength of model i.
  • Only score differences matter.
  • Pairwise human votes estimate the xi(i)​ values.
xA(i)​−xB(i)​=log3⇒P(A≻B)=43​.

Exercise: Bradley–Terry update — Assume model A beats model B and xA(i)​=1.2, xB(i)​=0.4.

  1. Compute p=P(A≻B)=σ(xA(i)​−xB(i)​).
  2. For L=−logp, show that ∂xA(i)​∂L​=p−1, ∂xB(i)​∂L​=1−p.
  3. Perform one SGD step with learning rate η=0.1.

Chatbot Arena (LMSYS): 用户输入自己的真实提示, 两个匿名模型各给一个回答, 用户投票选哪个更好 (或平局); 投完才揭晓模型名字; 把大量两两投票汇总成排名.

汇总用 Bradley–Terry 模型: 每个模型有一个潜在实力值 x, 模型 i 胜过 j 的概率是 σ(xi​−xj​). 只有差值有意义 (所有 x 加同一个常数, 概率不变). 用投票数据做最大似然估计 x (就是 11.1 节奖励模型的同一个损失). 例: 实力差 log 3 时, P=elog3+1elog3​=43​.

练习的解 (Python 验算): ① p=σ(1.2−0.4)=σ(0.8)=0.690. ② L=−logσ(d), d=xA​−xB​; 由 σ′(d)=σ(d)(1−σ(d)) 得 ∂L/∂d=−(1−p); 又 ∂d/∂xA​=1, ∂d/∂xB​=−1, 所以 ∂L/∂xA​=p−1=−0.310, ∂L/∂xB​=1−p=0.310. ③ 梯度下降: xA​←1.2−0.1⋅(−0.310)=1.231, xB​←0.4−0.1⋅0.310=0.369. 赢家的分数上升, 输家下降, 新的 p=σ(0.862)=0.703. 越是「意料之中」的胜利 (p 接近 1), 更新越小; 爆冷时更新大, 和国际象棋的 Elo 等级分同理.

幻灯片小错: 实力值写成 xi(i)​ (下标和上标都是 i, 而且是粗体向量记号), 应当是标量 xi​; 「xA(i)​」里的上标 (i) 没有任何含义, 像是宏定义写错了.

IFEval: 可验证的指令
IFEval: verifiable instructions · prompt-level vs. instruction-level scores

Slide 14–15

Instruction following is often open-ended. IFEval instead uses instructions that can be checked automatically. Examples:

  • write more than a given number of words,
  • include a specified keyword,
  • return valid JSON,
  • avoid a particular punctuation mark,
  • use a required number of bullet points.

A prompt may contain several verifiable instructions.

instruction 1instruction 2instruction 3
prompt 1111
prompt 2101

Instruction-level accuracy: 65​. Prompt-level accuracy: 21​, because a prompt succeeds only if all its instructions are satisfied.

遵循指令通常是开放式的, 难以打分. IFEval 改用能自动检查的指令: 字数超过多少、包含某个关键词、返回合法 JSON、不用某个标点、使用规定数量的项目符号等. 读图: 提示「随意地总结一下美国的产假政策, 分两节 (Section 1 和 Section 2), 至少 25 句」, 程序直接检查回答里是否有两个节标题、句子数是否 ≥ 25, 不需要人或 LLM 评委.

一个提示可能包含多条指令, 所以有两种准确率: 指令级: 所有指令里满足了几条, 表中 6 条满足 5 条, 5/6; 提示级: 一个提示的所有指令都满足才算成功, 2 个提示里只有提示 1 成功, 1/2. 提示级更严格, 总是 ≤ 指令级.

校准
What is calibration? · Where do LLM confidence scores come from? · Calibration metrics · Exercise: Brier score

Slide 16–19

A model is calibrated if its confidence matches its empirical accuracy. Among predictions with confidence 0.8, about 80% should be correct.

Several signals can be used as confidence estimates.

  • Internal probability: use token probabilities or answer probabilities.
  • Verbalized confidence: ask the model to report a probability.
  • Self-consistency: sample several answers and measure agreement.
  • Auxiliary estimator: train a separate model to predict correctness.
  • Inter-model agreement: compare answers from several LLMs.

Reported or estimated confidence must itself be evaluated. Tian et al., 2023: Just Ask for Calibration · Xia et al., 2025

For binary correctness yi​∈{0,1} and confidence pi​:

Brier score Brier=N1​i=1∑N​(pi​−yi​)2.

Log loss −N1​i∑​[yi​logpi​+(1−yi​)log(1−pi​)].

Expected Calibration Error ECE=b∑​N∣Sb​∣​∣acc(Sb​)−conf(Sb​)∣.

Exercise: Brier score — Suppose a model answers three questions. (y1​,y2​,y3​)=(1,0,1), (p1​,p2​,p3​)=(0.9,0.8,0.6).

Brier=3(0.9−1)2+(0.8−0)2+(0.6−1)2​=30.01+0.64+0.16​=0.27.

Confident mistakes are costly.

Question: Compare this to always predicting confidence 0.6.

一个模型是校准的, 如果它的置信度和实际准确率一致: 在所有置信度 0.8 的预测里, 约 80% 应当正确. 读图: 可靠性图把预测按置信度分箱, 柱高是每箱的实际准确率, 对角虚线是完美校准. 左上: 用模型自己的对数概率 (采样估计), 柱子大多在对角线下方, 即过于自信, 校准误差 0.256; 右下: 让模型口头给出 4 个候选答案和各自的概率, 最接近对角线, 误差只有 0.065. Tian 等的结论 (标题「只要问就行」): 对 RLHF 训练过的模型, 口头报告的概率反而比内部概率校准得更好.

置信度的来源: 内部概率 (词元或答案的概率); 口头置信度 (让模型报一个概率); 自洽性 (采样多个答案看一致程度); 辅助估计器 (另训一个模型预测是否正确); 模型间一致 (比较多个 LLM 的答案). 无论哪种, 置信度本身都要被评估.

三个指标: Brier 分数 = 置信度和 0/1 结果之差的平方的平均, 越小越好; 对数损失 = 二元交叉熵, 对「很自信却错了」惩罚极重; ECE (期望校准误差) = 按置信度分箱, 每箱的准确率和平均置信度之差的绝对值, 按箱中样本比例加权. 前两个同时衡量区分能力和校准, ECE 只衡量校准 (一个永远输出总体准确率的模型 ECE 为 0, 却毫无用处).

练习: Brier = 0.27, 主要来自第 2 题: 置信度 0.8 却错了, 贡献 0.64. 如果总是报 0.6: 3(0.6−1)2+(0.6−0)2+(0.6−1)2​=30.16+0.36+0.16​=0.227, 反而更好. 原模型对第 1 题的高置信度只省了 0.15, 第 2 题自信地错却多付了 0.28. 「自信的错误代价很高」.

按执行结果评估: SWE-bench 和 OSWorld
SWE-bench: testing code generation · OSWorld: evaluation through interaction

Slide 20–21

SWE-bench contains 2,294 software-engineering tasks from 12 popular Python repositories. Jimenez et al., 2023: SWE-bench

issue + repository → model patch → tests

A task is solved only if the generated patch fixes the issue without breaking existing functionality. Evaluation is based on executable outcomes.

OSWorld evaluates agents on real computer tasks across applications and operating systems. s0​→a1​→s1​→⋯→sT​.

(Screenshots verschiedener Desktop-Anwendungen, in denen der Agent Aufgaben ausführt.)

The agent observes the computer state, acts through mouse and keyboard, and is evaluated from the resulting environment state.

The target is successful task completion. Xie et al., 2024: OSWorld

SWE-bench: 来自 12 个流行 Python 仓库 (django、scikit-learn、sympy 等) 的 2294 个真实软件工程任务. 输入一个 GitHub issue 和整个代码库, 模型生成补丁, 然后跑测试. 读图: issue 报告 sklearn 的 GBDT 在热启动时有数据泄漏; 模型修改 gradient_boosting.py 等文件; 单元测试里, 补丁前失败的测试 (✗) 补丁后通过 (✓), 原本通过的测试仍然通过. 只有既修好了问题又没破坏现有功能才算解决; 评估基于可执行的结果, 不需要评委.

OSWorld: 智能体在真实电脑上跨应用、跨操作系统完成任务 (比如「把这个表格的第二列改成百分比格式」). 过程是状态 → 动作 → 新状态的序列; 智能体观察屏幕状态, 通过鼠标和键盘操作, 最后根据环境的最终状态 (文件内容、设置) 判断是否完成. 目标是任务完成.

基准污染
Benchmark Contamination · What is benchmark contamination? · How can contamination be detected? · Test-set slot guessing

Slide 22–25

Benchmark Contamination — Has the model already seen the test set?

A benchmark should test generalization to unseen examples. But test items may appear in training data: Dtrain​∩Dtest​=∅.

Contamination can include

  • exact duplicates,
  • near-duplicates or paraphrases,
  • answer options or metadata,
  • benchmark-targeted fine-tuning.

High benchmark performance may reflect exposure, not generalization.

  • Corpus search: search known training corpora for exact or near-duplicate benchmark items.
  • Test-set slot guessing: mask an answer option or unusual word and ask the model to reconstruct it.
  • Perturbation tests: compare performance on original items with changed variants.
  • Clean subsets: remove suspected contaminated examples and recompute performance.

Deng et al., 2023 test whether models can reconstruct hidden parts of benchmark items. For MMLU, they hide one wrong answer option and ask the model to guess it.

  • ChatGPT exact-match rate: about 52%.
  • GPT-4 exact-match rate: about 57%.
  • Random guessing would be much lower.

基准应当测试对没见过的样本的泛化, 但测试题可能出现在训练数据里 (训练集和测试集交集非空). 污染可能是: 完全重复; 近似重复或改写; 答案选项或元数据; 专门针对基准的微调. 高分可能只说明模型见过题, 而不是会做.

检测方法: 语料搜索 (在已知的训练语料里找重复或近似重复的题); 测试集槽位猜测 (遮住一个选项或不寻常的词, 让模型补出来); 扰动测试 (比较原题和改动后变体上的表现, 见过原题的模型在变体上会明显下降); 干净子集 (去掉疑似污染的题重算分数). 读图: 右边的例子: 「风疹如何导致胎儿畸形?」, 遮住选项 C, 被污染的模型准确说出了被遮的选项原文.

Deng 等在 MMLU 上遮住一个错误选项让模型猜: ChatGPT 精确匹配约 52%, GPT-4 约 57%. 一个错误选项是出题人随意编的, 没见过题几乎不可能一字不差地猜中, 这强烈暗示 MMLU 的题出现在了它们的训练数据里. 读表: 在 PIQA、HellaSwag 等其他基准上精确匹配率接近 0; 开源的 LLaMa 2-13B、Mistral-7B 在 MMLU 上也几乎为 0, 但 Mistral 在 TruthfulQA 上有 0.15.

评估范式与要点
Evaluation paradigms · LLM evaluation: main takeaways

Slide 26–27
MMLUWas the selected answer correct?
MT-BenchDoes a judge prefer or score the response?
Chatbot ArenaWhich model do humans prefer?
IFEvalWere explicit instructions satisfied?
CalibrationDoes confidence match correctness?
SWE-benchDoes the generated patch pass the tests?
OSWorldDid interaction accomplish the task?
Contamination testsWas the benchmark truly unseen?
  • Judgment for Open-ended outputs: MT-Bench uses LLM judges; Arena uses human pairwise preferences.
  • IFEval checks explicit instruction constraints automatically.
  • Accuracy can be complemented by confidence calibration metrics.
  • SWE-bench and OSWorld measure execution and interaction outcomes.
  • Contamination can make test performance invalid.

每个评估范式问的问题不同: MMLU 问选的答案对不对; MT-Bench 问评委偏爱或打几分; Chatbot Arena 问人更偏爱哪个模型; IFEval 问显式的指令是否满足; 校准问置信度是否和正确性一致; SWE-bench 问补丁能否通过测试; OSWorld 问交互是否完成了任务; 污染测试问基准是否真的没见过. 要点: 开放式输出靠评判 (MT-Bench 用 LLM 评委, Arena 用人的成对偏好); IFEval 自动检查显式约束; 准确率之外可以加校准指标; SWE-bench 和 OSWorld 衡量执行和交互的结果; 污染会让测试成绩失效.
